title: Explain the accounting for transfers of investments

items.concept: Initial AFS recognition; period-end OCI fair-value adjustment; AFS→HTM transfer at fair value with no NI effect; subsequent measurement schedule amortizing AOCI unrealized loss as yield adjustment (offsetting discount amortization); interest JEs; maturity settlement; transfer disclosure
Number-variant twin: AFS initial recognition; OCI fair-value adjustment; AFS→HTM transfer; subsequent AOCI/discount amortization schedule; period-end interest JEs; maturity
Transfer HTM→AFS (FV through OCI, no NI); transfer AFS→TS (holding loss to NI); transfer equity FV-NI→equity method (FV becomes new cost basis); subsequent TS fair-value adjustment and disposal
Classification — which transfer recognizes holding gains/losses in net income on the transfer date
